term: cause (productive principle in the narrow Hume reading)
definition: The productive principle whose idea is separated from the idea of a beginning in I.3.3 §3. No-cause excludes self-cause and nothing-as-cause in §§5–7. This is a description-level usage and does not identify the corpus’s distinct mover, act/potency, or per-se-order senses.
note: Local reading interface for issue #248; no account of causal production or temporal ontology is supplied. A more substantive formalization needs its own source-backed account.
